coverage_summary: The main modality routes are represented, but the graph omits documented length caps, applies an unsupported shared tokenizer route to Gemma, misbinds the ESM-3 input, uses concatenation for unresolved protein placeholder insertion, and omits the protein-RL interaction-context condition.

findings.detail: The DNA route clips the DNA sequence but omits the separately documented 1024-token text-length cap.

evidence.quote: The maximum DNA sequence length is 2048 nucleotides and the maximum text length is 1024 tokens.

findings.required_change: Add the documented text-length selection/cap after tokenization or preserve it as an explicit input constraint.

findings.detail: The DNA route omits the documented text-length cap for the shared Qwen1.7B/Qwen4B configuration.

evidence.quote: The maximum DNA sequence length is 2048 nucleotides and the maximum text length is 1024 tokens.

findings.required_change: Add the 1024-token text cap to the text-input path.

findings.detail: The CPT graph tokenizes the corpus but omits the documented maximum input length of 1024 tokens.

evidence.quote: Inputs are tokenized with a maximum length of 1024 tokens.

findings.required_change: Add the documented 1024-token cap as a selection/truncation constraint after tokenization.

findings.detail: The RNA trajectory applies a generic native-tokenizer and shared embedding-table route to Gemma, although the cited tokenizer statement documents only Qwen3. Gemma is merely identified as a separate backbone ablation.

evidence.quote: The text backbones for RNA CPT, SFT, and RL are Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen34B, loaded with their native tokenizers [75].
To test whether our main findings depend on the choice of base model, we repeat the RNA experiments with an off-the-shelf backbone Gemma model [76].

findings.required_change: Split the Qwen and Gemma routes or leave Gemma tokenizer/embedding behavior unresolved; do not assert a shared tokenizer vocabulary or table.

findings.detail: The RNA graph omits the documented 1024-token maximum text length.

evidence.quote: The maximum text length is 1024 tokens.

findings.required_change: Add the 1024-token cap to the RNA text path.

findings.detail: The opaque ESM-3 encoder is bound to protein_text_context, which conflates the textual prompt with the amino-acid sequence that supplies per-residue encoder inputs. No concrete protein-sequence node is present.

evidence.quote: Both the SFT and RL prompts concatenate (i) a system instruction describing the task and available biological context, (ii) a header containing the protein name, organism, and amino-acid sequence, and (iii) a user instruction asking the model to emit GO identifiers across the molecular function, biological process, and cellular component aspects [89].

Per-residue embeddings are extracted from layer 37 of ESM-3, projected through a trainable linear layer into the text-embedding space, and inserted at the protein placeholder positions before the text tokens [52].

findings.required_change: Add a protein amino-acid sequence node and bind it to the opaque ESM-3 boundary; keep organism, InterPro, interaction, and GO context on the prompt-serialization path.

findings.detail: The protein placeholder step uses concatenate even though the paper states insertion at placeholder positions and the exact variable-length replacement mechanics are unresolved. Concatenating the full placeholder-bearing text embeddings with protein features can duplicate placeholders and is unsupported.

evidence.quote: Per-residue embeddings are extracted from layer 37 of ESM-3, projected through a trainable linear layer into the text-embedding space, and inserted at the protein placeholder positions before the text tokens [52].

findings.required_change: Represent this as an unresolved opaque insertion/replacement boundary, or use a documented indexed-update representation only if the exact mechanics are established; remove the concatenate call.

findings.detail: The protein graph treats interaction context as generally available, but the paper explicitly excludes protein-protein interactions from the protein RL prompt.

evidence.quote: We include InterPro features in the prompt but exclude protein-protein interactions [74, 90].

findings.required_change: Add a lifecycle-conditioned bypass for protein-protein interaction context on the RL route while preserving the documented SFT context.

findings.detail: The protein route omits the documented maximum text and protein sequence lengths.

evidence.quote: The maximum text sequence length is 10 , 000 tokens and the maximum protein length is 2000 residues.

findings.required_change: Add the documented 10,000-token text cap and 2,000-residue protein cap, while retaining uncertainty about the exact variable-length insertion mechanics.
